thread:
alice: heads-up — we need a small, unambiguous metrics contract for the new wait-time / batch-size surfaces in Console. Goal: enable routing policy dashboards, quota-aware alerts, and rollout UX. can runtime/infra agree on minimal labels and ingest expectations?
ben: yes. proposing three canonical series: `batch_wait_seconds_bucket` (histogram), `batch_size_distribution` (histogram), and `queue_saturation_ratio` (gauge).
ben: quick proto prometheus queries:```
# p50/p90/p99 wait
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(batch_wait_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, model))
histogram_quantile(0.9, sum(rate(batch_wait_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, model))
# batch size distribution (percentile)
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(batch_size_distribution_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, model))
# saturation as in-utilization / capacity
avg_over_time(queue_saturation_ratio{route=~".*"}[5m])
```
carol: on infra side we care about cardinality — route, model, region, quota_tier are fine. please avoid adding request_id or user_id as labels. also add `instance` for shard id.
carol: ingest constraints: high-cardinality histograms at 1s scrape -> heavy. suggest 15s scrape and 1m rollup for long-term retention. can runtime emit both raw (15s) and a 1m aggregated rollup?
dan: product/console note — for rollouts we want ability to compare two routes side-by-side (canary vs stable). need consistent label for rollout_id or rollout_stage so panels can split. minimal: `rollout_stage` with values `canary|stable|fallback`.
frank: SRE requirements: alerting thresholds: fire a saturation alert when `queue_saturation_ratio` > 0.85 for 3m AND p99 wait > 200ms for same route/model. Also alert on drop in batch_size median < configured baseline for 10m (indicates underfill).
maria: agree with labels. telemetry contract draft that I can put in repo:`metric_name,help,type,labels,preferred_scrape_interval,rollup_interval` e.g.
```
batch_wait_seconds_bucket,"time spent waiting before dispatch",histogram,[route,model,region,quota_tier,instance,rollout_stage],15s,1m
```
alice: UX constraints — Console will render: (1) heatmap of wait percentiles by route/model, (2) histogram of batch sizes with sampling slider, (3) saturation timeline with simple threshold toggles. we need stable metric names and rollout_stage to wire canary compare.
ben: runtime implementation notes — we can emit `batch_wait_seconds_bucket` natively from dispatch layer. will tag by `route` and `route_hash` for deterministic grouping; we can add `rollout_stage` where the router attaches policy. runtime will produce raw 10s buckets and an aggregated 1m series via an internal aggregator.
carol: infra will accept raw 10s if you can confirm cardinality stays < ~5k series per cluster. otherwise we will only accept 1m rollups. please add a telemetry toggle (per-deploy flag) so we can ramp.
frank: operational playbook snippet to include in handoff: short-circuit routing to fallback when saturation > 0.95 OR if p99 wait > 500ms. document runbook steps for paging and mitigations.
maria: I'll add schema + sample Grafana panels to the repo. panel JSON will include variable bindings: `route`, `model`, `rollout_stage`, `region`. suggest we include example queries and panel thresholds.
alice: timeline? would like a small beta in dev env next week, canary in staging after that, then console integration. can we aim for dev rollout on Thu?
ben: runtime patch ready by Tue EOD. needs infra toggle and schema doc. i'll attach PR once tests pass.
carol: infra will stand up a temporary scrape target and retention policy for dev. team oncall can inspect.
frank: i'll draft the alerts and a short slack playbook for oncall to use during the beta.
infra-bot: deploy requested by ben to `dev` cluster for `dispatch-metrics` at commit abc123 — CI passed. :rocket:
alice: perfect — thanks everyone. i'll track the integration tasks in the console board and ping when panels are ready to link. :thumbsup:
